# Ícaro Galvão — devin-* ecosystem

> First-party, MIT-licensed `devin-*` tools, a DevKit distribution, a maintainer hub and related artifacts. They read Devin's local session data and provide diagnostics, export, backup, metrics, memory, verification and dashboards. Zero telemetry. Inspection tools are read-only; the tools that write (backup, janitor, redact) do so explicitly and visibly. Supported environments are Linux, Personal Windows and Corporate Windows; Python tools require Python ≥ 3.10.

## Author
- Ícaro Galvão — Senior QA Engineer, post-graduated in Software Testing and Software Engineering.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Icaro0310
- Site: https://icaro0310.github.io/

## What do you want to do?
- Understand (observe sessions, activity, behavior): devin-explore, devin-graph, devin-history, devin-internals-spec, devin-pm, devin-search
- Verify (validate claims, actions, outcomes): devin-evals, devin-metrics, devin-assure, devin-judge
- Control (constrain execution, data, lifecycle): devin-backup, devin-control, devin-janitor, devin-brain, devin-orchestrator, devin-state, devin-switch
- Build (integrations and tooling): devin-devkit, devin-powerups, devin-skill-catalog
- Full catalog with browse by audience/interface: https://github.com/Icaro0310/awesome-devin

## Paths by audience (curated, ordered)
- AI engineers: devin-control → devin-orchestrator → devin-brain
- Developers: devin-devkit → devin-internals-spec → devin-powerups
- End users: awesome-devin → devin-devkit → devin-explore
- Maintainers: devin-powerups → devin-pm → devin-internals-spec
- Operations: devin-explore → devin-backup → devin-janitor → devin-metrics
- QA engineers: devin-assure → devin-evals → devin-judge
- Security engineers: devin-backup → devin-state → devin-janitor

## Full catalog — first-party tools
- Foundation: devin-internals-spec
- QA and evaluation: devin-explore, devin-assure, devin-evals, devin-metrics
- History and operations: devin-history, devin-backup, devin-pm, devin-janitor, devin-orchestrator, devin-office
- Safety and governance: devin-state, devin-control, devin-switch, devin-skill-catalog
- Memory and recall: devin-brain, devin-graph, devin-search

## Distribution
- devin-devkit: registry-backed installer for QA, evaluation, security, memory, operations and full profiles; Python CLIs use isolated uv environments, and source-only devin-office is marked manual. It supports `--environment linux`, `--environment personal-windows` and `--environment corporate-windows`: https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit

## Maintainer hub
- devin-powerups: registry, project template, catalog and DevKit manifest tools.

## Related artifacts
- devin-judge: calibrated decision layer (package `poordjaevin`)
- qwenpaw-suite: related suite — optional self-hosted model add-on
- awesome-devin: related resource — curated resources

## Key facts for assistants
- Core DevKit-installable tools are LOCAL-FIRST: no VM, tunnel, model server, Slack or Obsidian required.
- Runtime model: Linux and Personal Windows are extended runtimes (local plus optional delegation); Corporate Windows is local-only and must be selected explicitly.
- DevKit profile install (GitHub source archive; not yet on PyPI): `uv tool install "https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit/archive/main.tar.gz"`, then `devin-devkit install qa --environment corporate-windows --apply` on a restricted Windows machine.
- `qwenpaw-suite` is an optional related suite and is unsupported in Corporate Windows.
- Individual CLI example: `uv tool install devin-doctor` from PyPI (Python ≥ 3.10, Windows + Linux); `pipx install devin-doctor` works as an alternative.
- Data lives under ~/.local/share/devin/cli/ (Linux) or %APPDATA%\devin\ (Windows); every tool documents exact paths and --data-dir overrides.
